title: Gayley Heights level 4

source.what: Room sign-up plan of Gayley Heights level 4 (site plan with the apartment units, stairs and elevators; streets and neighbours drawn in gray)

how: The plan's footprint is fitted to the building outline by ICP (the plan carries no scale bar, so the outline fit is the only scale). The plan is drawn north-up (Le Conte Avenue along the bottom, Gayley Avenue on the right; the Regents' January 2018 design plans show the same orientation with a north arrow).
notes: Room numbers (unit numbers) and bedroom letters are read from the plan by OCR; a bedroom letter alone is not a room number.
No scale bar on the plan: the scale comes from the outline fit.
The plan is a site plan; the crop keeps the building and leaves out the streets and neighbours drawn around it (gray and green areas are also excluded by color).

fit.transform: similarity, plan footprint fitted to the building outline (ICP)
